lista.descripcion: Aprende Peque · Series Infantiles
The Squirrels go to a fancy party at King Tiger's house and become embroiled in a mystery when the prized ruby centrepiece disappears from his party crown.
When Eugene unexpectedly drops out of running the summer fair, Duggee and the Squirrels hold an election to choose the best candidate for the job.
The Squirrels are exploring in the attic when they find an old cassette tape. They decide to make a mixtape for Duggee to remind him of all the happy memories they’ve made while earning their badges.

Duggee is making a smoothie, and the Squirrels can’t agree on whether it’s delicious or horrible. So they make their own adventurous smoothies using their favourite flavours to discover what taste is.
Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturise themselves to go on a voyage of discovery inside Enid. Can they find out what’s making her cough?
Happy sees a very questionable-looking puddle that he is determined to splash in, much to the horror of Duggee, the other Squirrels and the tiny citizens of Midgetropolis who live inside it.

One discovers it's tricky to play tennis when you're the only block in the world. She bumps into a magic mirror and meets another One, and they join forces to make Two. Learn a thing or two about adding with the Numberblocks.
Two finds a pair of magic dancing shoes and shows One that everything is better with two, singing and counting things that belong in pairs. Learn all about the number two with Numberblock Two.
Three arrives with a bang and a song-and-dance about her favourite number - 1, 2, 3, Everybody Look at Me! Learn all about the number three with Numberblock Three.
Three does magic tricks with apples to show the others who goes first, who is biggest and how to surprise your number friends. Learn about simple counting, ordering and adding with the Numberblocks.
The animated adventures of friends who can always count on each other. Four is the new block on the block and he can't wait to share how much he loves to be square.
The animated adventures of friends who can always count on each other. Five arrives to get the band together, and the party started, with a big high five.
Baby Peg tries to tell Mom she wants a stray kitty for her pet and problem-solving partner.
When Pocoyo, Pato, and Elly reunite with each other after each going on vacation, they all tell each other what they did while they were gone, but no one believes each other's story.
When Pato can't cut down a tree for Christmas due to his kind-hearted nature, Pocoyo and his friends cheer him up by making their own Christmas tree.
Pocoyo encounters some baby chicks and becomes fascinated with them. His friends help him learn how to care for the little birds.
Pocoyo discovers a telephone and becomes excited about calling his friends. He learns about communication and how to use a phone properly.
Pocoyo and his friends get messy while playing outside. They learn about cleanliness and the fun of getting dirty sometimes.
Sigue las aventuras de un cachorro de Blue Heeler que vive con su papá, su madre y su hermanita.
¡Toda la familia juega al escondite! Todos se esconden y Bluey cuenta hasta veinte, pero ¿será capaz de concentrarse en el juego y de no distraerse con todos sus juguetes?
Estando de acampada, Bluey hace un nuevo amigo que se llama Jean-Luc. Puede que Bluey no hable su idioma, pero dan con la forma de entenderse a través del juego y cazando a papá, que hace de jabalí.

Bingo y Bluey tienen que irse a la cama en cinco minutos, el tiempo justo para echar una carrera hasta lo alto del Monte Mamaypapá. Las fuertes tormentas, las avalanchas y los puntos malolientes harán necesario el trabajo en equipo.

El padre de Bluey quiere entrar un momento a la tienda, pero todo se complica cuando las niñas deciden que quieren jugar a los "Niños". Ahora, Bluey es la madre, Bingo su ojito derecho y el padre es un hijo muy travieso.

¡Es la hora de irse a la cama y Bingo no se acuerda de dónde ha dejado a su querido Blandi! Las niñas le van contando a su madre las cosas algo extrañas que han hecho con la esperanza de que aparezca.
Papa explains that the best way to approach a problem is to think carefully before tackling it, but Oona and Baba find his advice difficult to follow.

Para un concurso, Cleo y Pelusín le sacan una foto a un dragón, pero Cuquín la rompe sin querer. Cleo sabe qué hacer: un safari en el jardín. ¿Encontrarán lo que buscan?
Mientras juegan en el jardín, Pie Grande cae sobre unas plantas y se lastima. Para curarse, no se puede rascar... pero eso es muy difícil. ¿Podrán los chicos ayudarlo?
